data.name: Radee
data.gender_notes: Radee is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Radee is a name that means 'gifted' or 'generous' in Arabic and Urdu. This name is often given to babies who are believed to have a bright future ahead of them, as they possess a natural intelligence and a kind and giving nature. The name Radee carries the meaning “Gifted, Intelligent, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Radee usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, intelligent, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Radee represents the gift of knowledge and understanding from Allah. It is a name that encourages the bearer to seek wisdom and use their intelligence for the greater good.
data.etymology: Radee belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted, Intelligent, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Radee total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hindi.name: राज़ी
